deck.caption:
When banking systems face AI-driven cyber attacks, panic creates an even bigger trap: fake recovery agents who took $11M without fixing anything.

Here is what you need to know:
• How the secondary scam extracted $11M from locked financial systems
• Why third-party 'unlocking' promises are dangerous illusions
• How everyday bank account holders can protect their funds during system outages

Save this breakdown for your digital safety, and share it with family members using digital banking.

If your banking app freezes during an outage, do you wait for branch circulars or search online for customer helpline numbers?

#BankingSecurity #CyberSafety #FinancialLiteracy #DigitalBanking

slides.title: When banks face AI attacks, fake 'recovery agents' took $11M in extra losses
slides.text: Cyber thieves locked institutional systems with AI, but the biggest secondary loss came from hiring unverified 'fixers' who promised to restore data.

flowchart_data.text: AI tools breach and lock institutional banking infrastructure
Panic causes entities to seek urgent outside data restoration
Unverified recovery agents collect fees and disappear

slides.title: The documented cost of fake recovery

stat_data.label: Paid to fraudulent recovery intermediaries
stat_data.context: Reported losses in 2026 where financial institutions paid third parties who failed to recover locked systems.

comparison_data.myth: Third-party internet agents can safely unlock frozen bank databases.
comparison_data.reality: Ransomware recovery scams pocket upfront payments, leaving data locked and funds gone.

slides.title: What this means for everyday savers
slides.card_text: When institutional networks get hit, local ATMs and digital transfers can temporarily pause. Fraudsters use this window to call account holders posing as bank IT staff to 'verify' login pins. Real banks never ask for passwords to fix system downtime.

slides.title: Safety checks during a banking outage

checklist_data.item: Rely only on official bank notices at your physical branch
Never share OTPs with callers offering to 'speed up' transfers
Search third-party social media numbers for branch helplines

slides.title: What remains uncertain
slides.card_text: Regulators have not fully established how much retail insurance shields individual accounts if an institution suffers major capital loss from AI cyber attacks. The speed of system recovery without paying middlemen remains unstandardized.

slides.title: Never trust outside 'agents' to unlock money
slides.cta_detail: Save this slide. If your banking services freeze, wait for verified notifications from your bank's registered office. Never send money or codes to anyone promising quick restoration.
